problem:
Which of the following products is the LU factorization of a matrix $A?$

- $A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]$
- $A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ -4 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}]$
- $A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 & -1 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}]$

feedback.problem:
Which of the following products is the LU factorization of a matrix $C?$

- $C=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}]$
- $C=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}]$
- $C=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]$
feedback.worked_solution:
Remember that in the LU factorization of a matrix $C,$ we write $C=LU$ where the matrix $L$ is a unit lower triangular matrix (a lower triangular matrix that has only $1$'s on the main diagonal) and the matrix $U$ is an upper triangular matrix:

$$
C=\overset{L}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ ∗ & 1\end{aligned}]}}\cdot \overset{U}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & ∗\end{aligned}]}}
$$

With that in mind, let's inspect each product in turn.

- The first product is in $LU$ form because the left matrix is a unit lower triangular matrix, and the right matrix is an upper triangular matrix. 

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\,✓
$$

- The second product is *not* in $LU$ form because the matrix on the left is not a unit lower triangular matrix, as it has a non-zero entry above the main diagonal. 

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\,\times 
$$

- The third product is *not* in $LU$ form because the matrix on the left is not a unit lower triangular matrix, as it has an entry not equal to $1$ on the main diagonal.

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\,\times 
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only".
